test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the highlighted word.

The moral values in this nation were at their __***nadir***__ during the autocrat’s rule.
solution:
The correct answer is:** lowest point**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"nadir" **refers to the lowest point in the fortunes of a person or organization. (निम्नतम बिंदु)

 
 
• **Example: **The company's stocks hit their nadir amid fears of bankruptcy.
 
 
 
• The correct word,** "lowest point"**, accurat
